title.id: UU No. 14 Tahun 2001 tentang Paten (jangka waktu pelindungan saja)
title.en: Law No. 14 of 2001 on Patents (protection term only)

verification.note: Only the protection term is modelled (20 years Paten, 10 years Paten Sederhana from the filing date). Annuity timing under this law is not modelled: installments that fall in this era are approximated with the earliest later rule set and flagged. Law 13/2016 transitional provisions applied the new annuity regime to existing patents.
